description: Bus Stop locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council’s bus stop locations contains descriptions, boarding point and accessibility details, where commuters catch a public transport bus. Data includes Hastus ID, street name, nearest cross street, east/north, lat/long, suburb, bus stop type, tactile ground surface indicator, boarding point, road gradient, cross fall and date of last audit. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are arcgis, public transport, accessibility, bus, transport, travel. The portal shows 6,267 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
